title: Known-price reverse engineering is contaminated
evidence: Five expert plans with already-visible first/add/stop/target values were reverse engineered via local highs and Fibonacci; exact matches cannot be treated as a blind validation.
change: Benchmark the judgement process with unknown outcomes; known example numbers are not labels to train numeric imitation.
nextTest: Full-market point-in-time out-of-sample comparison with expert plans withheld.

title: Machine stops may be narrower than ordinary volatility or absurdly wide
evidence: 2026-10-13 V3 retrospective examples: 비나텍 reference 75,303 vs invalidation 74,923.5 (0.5%) with ATR ~8.26%; 뉴파워프라즈마 13,280 vs 8,450 (~36.4%) with ATR ~7.38%. Structurally plausible R/R cannot be assumed.
change: Human structural stop review, ATR/gap sanity and R/R review at both first and post-add exposure; reject artificial computed RR.
nextTest: Run audit on all 33 candidate plans and compare independently chosen structural stops.

title: Non-KRX executable price references
evidence: Prior raw machine references included 75,303, 74,923.5, 10,046.67; these are analytical values, not executable Korean exchange ticks. Historical 2026-10-13 OHLCV sources also displayed unverified vendor differences.
change: Separate analytical structural reference from rounded trade order; prove session/corporate-action alignment and tick rules before execution.
nextTest: Test instrument/session tick rounding on daily and live datasets; independently cross-check exchange closes.

title: First and second recommendation prices are contingent buys
evidence: User clarified expert 타점 = intended first buy, 물타기 = intended second buy, likely currency allocation 1:2; neither number records an actual fill. The allocation is not confirmed as original expert's contract.
change: Evaluate filled / unfilled paths and calculate capital-weighted average cost only conditional on both fills; do not force 1:2 or a fixed stop percent.
nextTest: Obtain independently observed portfolio sizing policy or evaluate several capital allocations.

title: Overusing deep pullback limits loses trending winners
evidence: Restricted 2026-09-18 diagnostic: LS에코에너지 intended first limit 53,400 but subsequent low 58,200; 산일전기 first limit 195,500 but subsequent low 199,600 through 2026-10-13. No fills despite later upward moves.
change: Compare pullback, breakout-retest and strong-trend continuation modes ex ante; keep nonfills and alternative chase risk.
nextTest: Clean locked test across market regimes including costly false breakouts.

title: A retrospective 33-stock 9/18 replay was not a clean blind discovery test
evidence: The cohort was selected by the 2026-10-13 V3 scanner, then cut back to 2026-09-18. Six passed a retrospective filter; three entry plans were proposed; one later target reached, two never entered. Future-selected cohort and analysis context create selection/hindsight biases.
change: Never claim all-market blind accuracy from a future-selected cohort; freeze complete universe and decisions before outcome; measure missed fills as well as wins.
nextTest: Independent 2026-09-18 KRX historical security-master universe with future-hidden deterministic scan.

title: CVD without price progress can be absorption
evidence: Previous chart-learning discussions identified repeat resistance 86,000–86,800 while aggressive-buy CVD remained elevated; reset anchors can make absolute CVD highs incomparable, and time-of-day volume does not prove price-volume void.
change: Interpret price progress against participation; check CVD reset/anchor and volume profile before declaring absorption or volume void.
nextTest: Multi-session controlled CVD/price-progress examples with homogeneous anchor and separate volume profile.

title: No-trade in a market crash does not prove stock-picking
evidence: 2026-10-13 top-10 V3 review found no approved entries during index stress. This demonstrates caution, not competence at selecting swing entries in healthy market regimes.
change: Test multiple market regimes and compare against an always-cash and a relevant market benchmark; track false-negative winners.
nextTest: Out-of-sample uptrend, range, correction and rebound cohorts.

title: Over-centering Yangbongman mistakenly elevates one view to governing doctrine
evidence: User explicitly corrected that Yangbongman is one view among many. Earlier assistant explanations over-emphasized that source despite the V3 objective of independent market judgement.
change: Do not privilege any expert, archived study or technical-analysis school. Use all as optional context lenses; select and compare interpretations based on market evidence, regime and out-of-sample utility. Preserve contradictions and permit abstention.
nextTest: Audit forthcoming chart reviews for source-driven anchoring and compare decisions before/after showing named-study interpretations.

title: Swing holding duration was incorrectly conflated with three-session blind review cadence
evidence: S01 ACTIVE_EPISODE.json specifies stepSessions=3 and episodeSessions=30. stock_blind_walkforward.py maintains positions across reviews with daily stop checks, while the assistant inaccurately described 3 days as if it were a complete swing evaluation horizon. User correctly noted swing positions can persist for several weeks.
change: Separate review cadence, thesis-dependent holding horizon, experiment duration, and realized/censored outcomes; evaluate longer independent episodes for multiweek or multimonth trades. Keep original locked S01 unchanged.
nextTest: Compare independent 30/60/90-session episodes with thesis-tagged holding lifetimes and separate realized, open, censored and cash-drag performance; prevent lookahead and avoid universal time exits.
